purpose: Track the upstream increment after the 2026-10-07 reference by AG99 capability and plugin-compatibility impact, not by source-code identity.

policy.goal: Improve AG99 while preserving plugin compatibility.
policy.version_alignment: Use AstrBot's version and public plugin contracts as compatibility anchors; do not bump the version only to mirror commit history.
policy.frontend_deployment: Frontend changes require a production build and synchronization to data/dist after validation.
policy.permission_ui_boundary: Adapt administrator guidance to AG99's existing computer-capability configuration. Do not add official local-permission mode hints without the matching AG99 setting and UI.

commits.title: feat: ship astrbot CLI in Docker image for in-container password reset (#10442)
commits.compatibility: The Docker image installs the project editable, exposes the astrbot CLI, and marks /AstrBot as initialized. Chinese and English Docker/FAQ guides describe password reset and restart requirements.
commits.validation: Dockerfile and guides reviewed against the upstream contract. A Docker image build/runtime check was not run.

commits.title: feat(dashboard): add distinct hints for local permission access modes (#10444)
commits.compatibility: The feature depends on LocalPermissionMatrix and computer_use_local_permissions, neither of which exists in AG99's runtime config or dashboard. The confirmed administrator-path guidance is already adapted to AG99's computer-capability configuration in 9a1d235c1 and cf8322d54. Adding files/full mode hints alone would advertise controls that do not exist.

commits.title: fix(computer-tools): point permission-denied hints at the Capabilities tab (#10445)
commits.compatibility: Computer-tool permission guidance points to AG99's existing computer-capability configuration and identifies the actual platform administrator-ID setting.
commits.validation: Computer-tool permission tests passed (3); the dashboard production build and data/dist hash verification passed in the local adaptation.

commits.title: test(computer-tools): expect the Capabilities path in permission error assertion (#10446)
commits.compatibility: The local permission assertion follows the AG99-specific guidance rather than importing the official Dashboard wording.
commits.validation: Included in the three passing computer-tool permission tests.

commits.title: fix(provider): keep Anthropic tool calls whose streamed input is empty (#10432)
commits.compatibility: Retains Anthropic tool-call start data when a stream emits no JSON input delta.

commits.title: fix: fall back from a failed context summary without long retries (#10436)
commits.compatibility: On summary failure, removes old history by complete conversation rounds while preserving the system message, tool-call chain, and newest round. The upstream retry parameter is not exposed by AG99's Provider API and was not fabricated.

commits.title: fix(provider): merge custom server tools with registered tools in Anthropic requests (#10437)
commits.compatibility: Combines provider-server tools with registered tools while preserving local override behavior for duplicate names in regular and streaming requests.

commits.title: fix: send Discord video components as attachments (#10423)
commits.compatibility: Maps Discord Video components to file attachments and preserves filename handling for URLs and local paths.
commits.validation: Video and Discord self-reply tests passed together (11).

commits.title: fix: preserve links and mentions in Slack lists (#10447)
commits.compatibility: Preserves Slack link and mention entities when converting list blocks to plugin-visible text.

commits.title: fix: preserve outbound Slack user mentions (#10448)
commits.compatibility: Retains Slack user mention syntax through sending and plain-text fallback paths.

commits.title: fix: prevent Discord self-reply loops (#10425)
commits.compatibility: Ignores messages authored by the current Discord bot while preserving the allow-other-bots setting.

commits.title: Fix/reject unresolvable image refs (#10434)
commits.compatibility: AG99 already rejects missing image references and safely drops failed materialization. Added an explicit regular-file check so directories, FIFOs, sockets, or devices cannot be treated as provider images; retained AG99's temporary-root and provider-boundary model.
commits.validation: Provider image materialization tests passed (12), including a non-regular directory reference; Ruff, compilation, and diff checks passed.

commits.title: chore(github): add plugin submission links to issue template config (#10455)
commits.compatibility: Repository issue-template metadata does not affect runtime behavior or the AstrBot plugin contract.

commits.title: fix: avoid recording cron sends without a matching platform (#10468)
commits.compatibility: CronMessageEvent already raises when its target platform does not confirm delivery, before marking the event as sent; this is stricter than returning early without recording a send. No source change was needed.

commits.title: fix: warn when a background task result is not sent to the user (#10398)
commits.compatibility: Retains AG99's structured delivery confirmation and upgrades the undelivered-result diagnostic from INFO to WARNING so it is visible in default logs.
commits.validation: Focused delivery-confirmed true/false tests passed (2); Ruff, compilation, and diff checks passed.

commits.title: fix: keep async tool generators in one task (#10474)
commits.compatibility: Drives tool and plugin async iterators in stable owner tasks, explicitly closes nested local/MCP/handoff iterators, and waits for cleanup on stop or cancellation. Persona tool output capture, timeout, and result projection remain local.
commits.validation: Tool executor tests passed (20); focused task-affinity and stop-cleanup tests passed (2); Ruff, compilation, and diff checks passed.
